description: Send messages, manage contacts and lists, and watch conversations and campaigns.

simpletexting_campaign_status_changed_tr.description: Runs each time a campaign status changes in SimpleTexting. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields campaignId, title, accountPhone, state, type, started, modified

parameters.description: Choose the sending number, or leave empty for all numbers.
parameters.name: account_phone

simpletexting_incoming_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new incoming text in SimpleTexting. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, text, contactPhone, accountPhone, directionType, timestamp, category

parameters.description: Choose the sending number, or leave empty for all numbers.
parameters.name: account_phone

simpletexting_new_campaign_trigger.description: Runs for each new campaign in SimpleTexting. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields campaignId, title, accountPhone, state, type, started, modified

parameters.description: Choose the sending number, or leave empty for all numbers.
parameters.name: account_phone

simpletexting_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in SimpleTexting. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields contactId, contactPhone, firstName, lastName, email, birthday, subscriptionStatus, updated, created

simpletexting_outgoing_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new outgoing text in SimpleTexting. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, text, contactPhone, accountPhone, directionType, timestamp, category

parameters.description: Choose the sending number, or leave empty for all numbers.
parameters.name: account_phone

simpletexting_updated_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each contact added or changed in SimpleTexting. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields contactId, contactPhone, firstName, lastName, email, birthday, subscriptionStatus, updated, created
